description: Arduino AVR core API contract library - Core functions for Arduino Mega 2560 and compatible boards

gpio.name: pinMode
gpio.description: Configure the specified pin to behave as INPUT or OUTPUT

params.name: pin
params.constraint: 0-53 for Mega2560 (digital pins); 0-13 for Uno; board-specific, see board.json pins

gpio.usage_example:
pinMode(LED_BUILTIN, OUTPUT);  // set built-in LED pin as output
pinMode(2, INPUT_PULLUP);         // enable pull-up on pin 2
preconditions: pin must be valid (0-53 for Mega)

common_errors.fix: Use pinMode(pin, mode) instead of setPinMode
Use symbolic constants: pinMode(13, OUTPUT) or pinMode(LED_BUILTIN, OUTPUT)

gpio.name: digitalWrite
gpio.description: Write HIGH or LOW to a digital pin
gpio.usage_example:
digitalWrite(LED_BUILTIN, HIGH);  // turn LED on
digitalWrite(13, LOW);            // turn pin 13 off
preconditions: pinMode must be set to OUTPUT first

gpio.name: digitalRead
gpio.description: Read the state of a digital pin (HIGH or LOW)
gpio.usage_example: int button = digitalRead(2);  // read button state on pin 2
preconditions: pinMode should be set to INPUT or INPUT_PULLUP

time.name: delay
time.description: Pause the program for the specified number of milliseconds
constraints: NEVER use delay() inside ISR (interrupt service routine)
NEVER use delay() with long durations in loop() if responsiveness matters

time.name: delayMicroseconds
time.description: Pause for the specified number of microseconds

time.name: millis
time.description: Returns the number of milliseconds since the program started
time.usage_example:
unsigned long now = millis();
if (now - lastTime >= 1000) { /* 1 second elapsed */ }
time.note: Non-blocking timing - preferred over delay() for responsive code

common_errors.fix: millis() does not increment inside ISR - use hardware timer instead

time.name: micros
time.description: Returns the number of microseconds since the program started
time.usage_example: unsigned long t = micros();  // high-resolution timestamp

serial.name: Serial.begin
serial.description: Initialize USART0 with specified baud rate (8N1 format)
preconditions: Must be called in setup() before any Serial.print/read
Pins 0(RX) and 1(TX) become unavailable for GPIO

board_specific.arduino_mega: USART0 on pins 0(RX), 1(TX); also has Serial1/Serial2/Serial3 for additional UARTs

serial.name: Serial.print
serial.description: Print data to the serial port as human-readable ASCII text

variants.name: Serial.println
variants.description: Same as print() but appends \r\n newline

serial.name: Serial.read
serial.description: Read incoming serial data (first byte available, or -1 if none)

returns.constraint: 0-255 for valid byte, -1 if buffer empty

serial.name: Serial.available
serial.description: Get the number of bytes available for reading from serial buffer

serial.name: Serial.write
serial.description: Write binary data to serial port (single byte)

returns.note: Number of bytes written (always 1 for single byte)

serial.name: Serial.flush
serial.description: Wait for all outgoing serial data to be transmitted
serial.usage_example: Serial.flush();  // ensure all data sent before doing something else
serial.side_effects: Blocking - waits until TX buffer empty

serial.name: Serial.parseInt
serial.description: Read integer value from serial input

serial.name: Serial.println
serial.description: Print data followed by a newline character

serial.name: Serial.print
serial.description: Print data without a newline character

serial.name: Serial.write
serial.description: Write binary data to serial port

serial.name: Serial.flush
serial.description: Wait for outgoing serial data to complete

interrupt.name: attachInterrupt
interrupt.signature: void attachInterrupt(uint8_t interruptNum, void (*userFunc)(), int mode)
interrupt.description: Attach a function to an external interrupt pin

params.name: userFunc
params.constraint: ISR function: must be void return, no params, no blocking calls, no malloc

constraints: ISR function must NOT use delay(), Serial.print(), or malloc()
Keep ISR as short as possible
Use volatile for variables shared with ISR

interrupt.name: noInterrupts
interrupt.description: Disable all interrupts globally (cli instruction on AVR)
constraints: Do not keep interrupts disabled for long periods

interrupt.name: digitalPinToInterrupt
interrupt.description: Convert a digital pin number to interrupt number

analog.name: analogRead
analog.description: Read analog voltage from ADC pin (10-bit resolution, 0-1023)

params.name: pin
params.constraint: A0-A15 on Mega2560 (16 analog inputs). Use A0/A1/... constants not pin numbers

analog.usage_example:
int sensorValue = analogRead(A0);
float voltage = sensorValue * (5.0 / 1023.0);

analog.name: analogWrite
analog.description: Output PWM signal on supported pins (hardware PWM, not DAC)
analog.usage_example: analogWrite(9, 128);  // 50% duty cycle PWM on pin 9 (LED dim)
preconditions: pinMode is not required (analogWrite sets it automatically)

common_errors.fix: Check pin supports PWM; use digitalWrite if on/off only needed

analog.name: analogReference
analog.description: Configure the reference voltage for analog input

params.name: type
params.note: DEFAULT=5V; INTERNAL1V1=1.1V internal ref; EXTERNAL=AREF pin

analog.usage_example: analogReference(INTERNAL);  // use internal 1.1V reference for precise readings
constraints: Do not exceed Vref voltage on any analog pin

i2c.name: Wire.begin
i2c.description: Initialize I2C (Wire) library as master. Joins I2C bus.
i2c.usage_example: Wire.begin();  // join I2C bus as master (Mega: SDA=20, SCL=21)
preconditions: SDA/SCL pins must have pull-up resistors (typically 4.7k to VCC)
Pin mode must be open-drain (handled by Wire library)

i2c.name: Wire.beginTransmission
i2c.description: Begin transmission to I2C device at specified address

params.name: address
params.constraint: 7-bit I2C address (0-127). Do NOT include R/W bit

i2c.usage_example: Wire.beginTransmission(0x3C);  // start talking to OLED at 0x3C

i2c.name: Wire.write
i2c.description: Queue a byte for I2C transmission

i2c.name: Wire.endTransmission
i2c.description: End transmission and send queued bytes to I2C device
i2c.usage_example:
byte result = Wire.endTransmission();
if (result != 0) { /* handle error */ }

i2c.name: Wire.requestFrom
i2c.description: Request bytes from I2C slave device

returns.note: Number of bytes returned from slave

i2c.name: Wire.available
i2c.description: Returns number of bytes available for reading after requestFrom

i2c.name: Wire.read
i2c.description: Read a byte from I2C buffer

returns.constraint: 0-255 for valid byte, -1 if no data

spi.name: SPI.begin
spi.usage_example: SPI.begin();  // init SPI (Mega: MOSI=51, MISO=50, SCK=52, SS=53)

board_specific.arduino_mega: MOSI pin 51, MISO pin 50, SCK pin 52, SS pin 53 (hardware CS)

spi.name: SPI.transfer
spi.description: Send and receive one byte over SPI simultaneously

returns.note: Byte received from slave simultaneously with transmission

spi.usage_example: byte received = SPI.transfer(0x42);  // send 0x42, receive slave response

spi.name: SPI.beginTransaction
spi.description: Begin SPI transaction with specified settings (speed, bit order, mode)

spi.name: SPI.endTransaction
spi.description: End SPI transaction (allows other SPI devices to use bus)

math.name: constrain
math.signature: x_type constrain(x_type x, x_type a, x_type b)
math.description: Constrain a value to be within a range: returns x if a <= x <= b, else a if x < a, b if x > b

returns.note: Same type as input, value clamped to [a, b]

math.name: map
math.signature: long map(long x, long in_min, long in_max, long out_min, long out_max)
math.description: Re-map a number from one range to another (linear interpolation with integer math)
math.note: Uses integer math - may lose precision. Does NOT constrain output to [out_min, out_max].

math.name: max
math.description: Return the larger of two values

math.name: min
math.description: Return the smaller of two values

math.name: pow
math.description: Return base raised to the power of exponent

math.name: sqrt
math.description: Return the square root of x

board_constants.name: LED_BUILTIN
board_constants.description: Built-in LED pin number for Arduino Mega 2560

board_constants.name: INPUT_PULLUP
board_constants.description: Pin mode: input with internal pull-up resistor enabled (~20k to VCC)

bit_operations.name: bitRead
bit_operations.description: Read bit n of byte x

bit_operations.name: bitSet
bit_operations.description: Set bit n of byte x (x |= 1<<n)
bit_operations.side_effects: Modifies hardware register if x is PORTx/DDRx

bit_operations.name: bitClear
bit_operations.description: Clear bit n of byte x (x &= ~(1<<n))

bit_operations.name: bitWrite
bit_operations.signature: void bitWrite(uint8_t &x, uint8_t n, uint8_t b)
bit_operations.description: Write bit b (0 or 1) to bit n of byte x
bit_operations.usage_example: bitWrite(PORTB, 7, HIGH);  // set PB7 to HIGH

random.name: random
random.description: Generate a pseudo-random number between min and max-1

advanced_io.name: tone
advanced_io.description: Generate a square wave of the specified frequency on a pin

advanced_io.name: noTone
advanced_io.description: Stop generating a tone on the specified pin

advanced_io.name: pulseIn
advanced_io.description: Read a pulse (HIGH or LOW) on a pin

advanced_io.name: shiftOut
advanced_io.description: Shift out a byte of data one bit at a time
